fusions.name: Shed Spores
fusions.desc: Shakes spores off you as you move, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Burst Puffball
fusions.desc: Lobs a puffball that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Spore Coat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Mildew in Their Eyes
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying a condition, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
